say:2:1310726001:1.text: This is beyond bizarre. I need to sort out my thoughts...
say:2:1310726001:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了，太奇怪了！我必须要好好思考，理清思路……

say:3:1310726002:1.text: Okay, the biggest problem is that everyone, except for us, thinks the festival isn't over. Wait, no... they don't even realize there was a festival yesterday.
say:3:1310726002:1.source_cn: 最大的问题是——除了我们，所有人都觉得祭典还没有结束…...

say:4:1310726003:1.text: Yeah, in their minds, the festival has just begun. They're doing and saying the same things as yesterday!
say:4:1310726003:1.source_cn: 对呀，在他们看来，这就是第一次祭典。他们就像是又回到了...

choice_prompt:5:1310726003.text: Yeah, in their minds, the festival has just begun. They're doing and saying the same things as yesterday!
choice_prompt:5:1310726003.source_cn: 对呀，在他们看来，这就是第一次祭典。他们就像是又回到了庆典刚开始一样，做同样的事，说同样的话！

say:6:1310726004:0.text: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...
say:6:1310726004:0.source_cn: 对对对，就是这样！他们就像陷入祭典那段时间里一样，不停...
say:6:1310726004:0.male: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...
say:6:1310726004:0.female: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...

say:7:1310726005:0.text: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.
say:7:1310726005:0.source_cn: 可是，如果发生了不同情况，那些人也会有不同反应，并不是...
say:7:1310726005:0.male: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.
say:7:1310726005:0.female: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.

say:8:1310726006:0.text: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...
say:8:1310726006:0.source_cn: 的确，那些人依旧有自己的意识，对不同情况也会有不同反应...
say:8:1310726006:0.male: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...
say:8:1310726006:0.female: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...

say:9:1310726007:0.text: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.
say:9:1310726007:0.source_cn: 物品不会被复制，但人却会重复他们做过的事情，太奇怪了！
say:9:1310726007:0.male: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.
say:9:1310726007:0.female: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.

say:10:1310726008:0.text: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!
say:10:1310726008:0.source_cn: 报告主人，满满发现今天的“祭典”和上次相比，少了一些人！
say:10:1310726008:0.male: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!
say:10:1310726008:0.female: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!

say:12:1310726009:0.text: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...
say:12:1310726009:0.source_cn: 咦，真的！鬼影密室和舞会里捣乱的亡灵不见了，连一直追着...
say:12:1310726009:0.male: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...
say:12:1310726009:0.female: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...

say:13:1310726010:0.text: Yeah, that little kid we built the snowmen with ran off somewhere, and the town also seemed to be less crowded than before.
say:13:1310726010:0.source_cn: 对，那个和我们一起堆雪人的小孩子不知道跑哪去了。镇子里...

say:13:1310726010:0.female: Yeah, that little kid we built the snowmen with ran off somewhere, and the town also seemed to be less crowded than before.

say:14:1310726011:0.text: This is really scary... Everyone is stuck in a time loop, and some people have disappeared...
say:14:1310726011:0.source_cn: 呀，真让人毛骨悚然……大家都浑浑噩噩地陷入了时间循环，...

say:15:1310726012:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this all has to do with those strange Graveborn?

say:15:1310726012:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this all has to do with those strange Graveborn?

say:16:1310726013:1.text: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.
say:16:1310726013:1.source_cn: 祭典里和亡灵相关的一切都消失了，就像是故意的一样！这里...
say:16:1310726013:1.male: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.
say:16:1310726013:1.female: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.

say:17:1310726014:1.text: Chippy remembers that during the lighting ceremony, Her Highness said that there were a lot of undead at the ancient battlefield at the back of the mountain.
say:17:1310726014:1.source_cn: 满满记得点火仪式的时候，公主殿下说过山脉背面的古战场里...

say:19:1310726015:1.text: Yes, Chippy was thinking the same thing! They tried to ruin the festival during the Ghostly Getaway and also the ball.
